result.title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
result.summary: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Visual Cipher Bench：40 道分属空间操作、逻辑约束规划、规则归纳与知识解码的视觉谜题，仅给一到三张黑白线图与极简提交说明，要求 agent 自行从图像中发现解法机制，并在 8 个前沿模型的 29 种推理强度配置上评测（最高仅 26.7%，子集上给一条机制提示可将准确率从 7.8% 提至 55.6%）。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接诊断多模态 agent 能否自主从视觉证据发现规则并反复查看、交叉核对线索，与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本、视觉证据筛选和停止决策直接相关；提示实验显示瓶颈在规则发现而非多步执行，可供核查，但不涉及内部 latent 状态的生成机制。
